1101.en: In the past, most students wrote their essays by hand.
1101.zh: 过去，大多数学生用手写论文。

1102.en: Previous experience is not required for this volunteer role.
1102.zh: 这个志愿者岗位不要求以往经验。

1103.en: The former factory is now a popular art centre.
1103.zh: 这家以前的工厂现在是很受欢迎的艺术中心。

1104.en: Applicants need no prior knowledge of the subject.
1104.zh: 申请者无需具备该学科的预备知识。

1105.en: An earlier study reached a similar conclusion.
1105.zh: 更早的一项研究得出了类似的结论。

1106.en: Please arrive ten minutes before the test begins.
1106.zh: 请在考试开始前十分钟到达。

1107.en: We can discuss your essay after the lecture.
1107.zh: 讲座结束后我们可以讨论你的论文。

1108.en: The results will be announced later this week.
1108.zh: 结果将于本周晚些时候公布。

1109.en: Answer the following questions in complete sentences.
1109.zh: 用完整的句子回答下列问题。

1110.en: The next train to the city leaves from platform two.
1110.zh: 下一班开往市区的火车从二号站台发车。

1111.en: The theory was confirmed by subsequent experiments.
1111.zh: 该理论被随后的实验所证实。

1112.en: The course prepares students for future careers in media.
1112.zh: 这门课程为学生未来的媒体职业做准备。

1113.en: Details of the coming term are in the handbook.
1113.zh: 下学期的详细安排在手册里。

1114.en: With exams approaching, the library is getting crowded.
1114.zh: 考试临近，图书馆越来越拥挤。

1115.en: Dark clouds warned of an imminent storm.
1115.zh: 乌云预示着暴风雨即将来临。

1116.en: Signs of the impending eruption worried the scientists.
1116.zh: 火山即将喷发的迹象令科学家们担忧。

1117.en: Posters advertise the upcoming music festival.
1117.zh: 海报在宣传即将举行的音乐节。

1118.translation: 即将出版的;乐于提供信息的
1118.en: Her forthcoming book is about desert ecosystems.
1118.zh: 她即将出版的书是关于沙漠生态系统的。

1119.en: Prospective students can tour the campus on Fridays.
1119.zh: 准学生们可以在周五参观校园。

1120.en: The site has great potential for wind power.
1120.zh: 这个地点具有发展风电的巨大潜力。

1121.en: Book early if possible, as seats fill up quickly.
1121.zh: 如有可能请尽早预订，座位很快订满。

1122.en: The probable cause of the delay was the bad weather.
1122.zh: 延误很可能是坏天气造成的。

1123.en: It is likely that the lecture will be recorded.
1123.zh: 这场讲座很可能会被录下来。

1124.en: It is unlikely to rain during the dry season.

1125.en: It is impossible to finish the reading list in one week.
1125.zh: 一周内读完书单上的书是不可能的。

1126.en: Success seemed improbable, but the team kept trying.
1126.zh: 成功似乎希望渺茫，但团队仍不断尝试。

1127.en: The committee will decide whether the plan is feasible.
1127.zh: 委员会将决定该计划是否可行。

1128.en: Solar power is now a viable option for many homes.
1128.zh: 太阳能现在对许多家庭来说是切实可行的选择。

1129.en: The course includes practical training in the studio.
1129.zh: 这门课程包括在工作室的实践训练。

1130.en: Set realistic goals for your first term.
1130.zh: 为第一学期设定现实的目标。

1131.en: The actual cost was much higher than the estimate.
1131.zh: 实际费用比估算高得多。

1132.en: The film is based on real events.
1132.zh: 这部电影根据真实事件改编。

1133.en: She showed a genuine interest in the local culture.
1133.zh: 她对当地文化表现出真正的兴趣。

1134.en: The restaurant serves authentic Thai food.
1134.zh: 这家餐厅供应正宗的泰国菜。

1135.en: Decide whether each statement is true or false.
1135.zh: 判断每个陈述是正确还是错误。

1136.en: The article contains several false claims.
1136.zh: 这篇文章包含几处不实说法。

1137.en: The museum discovered that the painting was fake.
1137.zh: 博物馆发现这幅画是赝品。

1138.en: The stadium uses artificial grass all year round.
1138.zh: 这座体育场全年使用人造草坪。

1139.en: Synthetic fabrics dry faster than cotton.
1139.zh: 合成面料比棉布干得快。

1140.en: The park protects the natural habitat of rare frogs.
1140.zh: 公园保护珍稀蛙类的自然栖息地。

1141.en: Organic vegetables are grown without chemical fertilisers.
1141.zh: 有机蔬菜不使用化肥种植。

1142.en: The lab studies the biological effects of noise on birds.
1142.zh: 实验室研究噪音对鸟类的生物学影响。

1143.zh: 经常进行体育活动能提高注意力。

1144.en: The tent is made from a lightweight waterproof material.
1144.zh: 这顶帐篷由轻质防水材料制成。

1145.en: The library received a substantial donation last year.
1145.zh: 图书馆去年收到了一笔可观的捐赠。

1146.en: Building the bridge took a considerable amount of time.
1146.zh: 建造这座桥花费了相当长的时间。

1147.en: There was a significant drop in air pollution last year.
1147.zh: 去年空气污染显著下降。

1148.en: It is important to back up your work regularly.
1148.zh: 定期备份你的作业很重要。

1149.en: Timing is crucial when planting these seeds.
1149.zh: 种这些种子时，时机至关重要。

1150.en: Clean water is critical to the village's survival.
1150.zh: 干净的水对这个村庄的生存至关重要。

1151.en: Bees are vital for pollinating food crops.
1151.zh: 蜜蜂对粮食作物授粉至关重要。

1152.en: Good time management is essential for exam success.
1152.zh: 良好的时间管理是考试成功的关键。

1153.en: Tourism is a key industry on the island.
1153.zh: 旅游业是这座岛的关键产业。

1154.en: The main entrance is on the north side of the building.

1155.en: The primary aim of the project is to reduce waste.
1155.zh: 该项目的首要目标是减少浪费。

1156.en: The principal reason for the delay was a staff shortage.
1156.zh: 延误的主要原因是人手短缺。

1157.en: Rice is the chief crop of the region.
1157.zh: 水稻是该地区的主要作物。

1158.en: The airport is undergoing major renovation work.
1158.zh: 机场正在进行大规模翻修。

1159.en: There are a few minor errors in the report.

1160.en: Cost is a secondary consideration; safety comes first.
1160.zh: 成本是次要考虑，安全第一。

1161.en: The company opened a subsidiary office in Singapore.
1161.zh: 这家公司在新加坡开设了附属办事处。

1162.en: The hospital hired more auxiliary staff for the winter.
1162.zh: 医院为冬季增聘了更多辅助人员。

1163.en: Supplementary reading materials are posted online.
1163.zh: 补充阅读材料发布在网上。

1164.en: Additional copies of the handout are available at the desk.
1164.zh: 讲义的额外副本可在服务台领取。

1165.en: There is an extra charge for late check-out.
1165.zh: 延迟退房需要额外收费。

1166.en: Always carry a spare battery for your camera.
1166.zh: 一定要为相机带一块备用电池。

1167.en: Surplus food from the canteen is given to a local charity.
1167.zh: 食堂剩余的食物捐给了当地慈善机构。

1168.en: Passengers must pay for luggage in excess of twenty kilos.
1168.zh: 行李超过二十公斤的乘客需要付费。

1169.en: Excessive screen time can affect children's sleep.
1169.zh: 过多的屏幕时间会影响儿童睡眠。

1170.en: The desert is known for its extreme temperatures.
1170.zh: 这片沙漠以极端气温著称。

1171.en: Athletes follow an intense training programme before the games.
1171.zh: 运动员在赛前进行高强度训练。

1172.en: The region suffered a severe drought last summer.
1172.zh: 该地区去年夏天遭遇了严重干旱。

1173.en: Plagiarism is a serious offence at university.
1173.zh: 抄袭在大学里是严重的违规行为。

1174.en: The doctor looked grave as she read the results.
1174.zh: 医生看结果时神情严肃。

1175.en: The building is in urgent need of repair.

1176.en: Housing is the most pressing problem facing the city.
1176.zh: 住房是这座城市面临的最紧迫的问题。

1177.en: The new rules will take immediate effect.

1178.en: The app gives instant feedback on your pronunciation.
1178.zh: 这款应用对你的发音给出即时反馈。

1179.en: Thank you for your prompt reply to my email.
1179.zh: 感谢你对我邮件的迅速回复。

1180.en: Let's have a quick look at the map before we set off.
1180.zh: 出发前我们快速看一下地图。

1181.en: The disease spreads at a rapid rate in crowded cities.
1181.zh: 这种疾病在拥挤的城市里传播迅速。

1182.en: The lifeguard made a swift decision to enter the water.
1182.zh: 救生员迅速决定下水救人。

1183.en: The fast train reaches the capital in two hours.

1184.en: Progress on the new library has been slow.
1184.zh: 新图书馆的工程进展缓慢。

1185.en: There has been a gradual improvement in water quality.

1186.en: The school takes a progressive approach to homework.
1186.zh: 这所学校对家庭作业采取渐进的方式。

1187.en: The project advances in small incremental steps.
1187.zh: 这个项目以小步递增的方式推进。

1188.en: She is a prominent figure in environmental research.
1188.zh: 她是环境研究领域的知名人物。

1189.en: Keep a steady pace during the long-distance run.
1189.zh: 长跑时保持平稳的速度。

1190.en: Her exam results have been consistent all year.
1190.zh: 她全年的考试成绩一直很稳定。

1191.en: The bricks are cut to a uniform size.
1191.zh: 这些砖被切成统一的尺寸。

1192.en: Divide the mixture into two equal parts.
1192.zh: 把混合物分成相等的两份。

1193.en: The twins wore identical jackets to the party.
1193.zh: 这对双胞胎穿着完全相同的外套参加聚会。

1194.en: We take the same bus to campus every morning.
1194.zh: 我们每天早上乘同一班公交车去学校。

1195.en: The two essays reach similar conclusions.
1195.zh: 这两篇论文得出了相似的结论。

1197.en: The two cities are comparable in size and population.
1197.zh: 这两座城市在面积和人口上不相上下。

1198.en: The qualification is equivalent to a British degree.
1198.zh: 该资格等同于英国学位。

1199.en: The same word can have different meanings in context.
1199.zh: 同一个词在不同语境中可能有不同的含义。

1200.en: The city is home to people from diverse cultural backgrounds.
1200.zh: 这座城市居住着来自多元文化背景的人们。
